result.brief: 提出 WISE：在冻结的世界动作模型上对采样 rollout 做动作有效性、时序规律性、逆动力学一致性与任务进度打分，选最优候选执行，提升闭环成功率。
result.reason: Test-time selection over world action model rollouts using inverse-dynamics consistency; main contribution is inference-time scoring for robot control, not representation or world-model learning.
